description: This file defines the implementation of the OrderService interface, providing methods for creating orders, deleting, verifying payments, and retrieving order data within a billing software system.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderService interface, providing business logic for order management including creation, deletion, payment verification, and retrieval.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order based on the provided request, initializes payment details, and saves it to the database.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an existing order identified by orderId.

methods.name: verifyPayment
methods.description: Verifies the payment for an order using Razorpay details and updates the order status accordingly.

methods.name: getLatestOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of the most recent orders, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: sumSalesByDate
methods.description: Calculates total sales for a specified date.

methods.name: countByOrderDate
methods.description: Counts the number of orders placed on a specific date.

methods.name: findRecentOrders
methods.description: Fetches the five most recent orders.

methods.name: convertToResponse
methods.description: Converts an OrderEntity to an OrderResponse object.

methods.name: convertToItemResponse
methods.description: Converts an OrderItemEntity to an OrderItemResponse.

methods.name: convertToOrderEntity
methods.description: Converts an OrderRequest to an OrderEntity.

methods.name: verifyRazorpaySignature
methods.description: Stub method for verifying Razorpay signatures, currently always returns true.
